description: Transition B011 from 'fastest benchmark' to 'production-safe default' by validating correctness, memory safety, and state lifecycle across repeated generations, unload/reload, context reset, and sustained runs.
experimental_question: Is B011 residency safe to enable by default for all inference workloads on this platform?

prompts: Hello world, this is a test of context reset behavior

success_criteria.repeated_generations: All 5 generations produce identical first token (determinism). No crash.
success_criteria.unload_reload: First token identical across unload/reload cycles. No crash.
success_criteria.context_reset: First token identical before/after context reset. No crash.
success_criteria.memory_growth: Working set growth < 5% across 10 generations. No monotonic leak.
success_criteria.equivalence_b010_b011: B010 and B011 produce identical first token for same prompt. No crash.
success_criteria.sustained_run: 32-token generation completes without anomaly. Working set delta < 10%.
